translations.web: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
translations.bsb: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in custody until the next day.
translations.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
